items.title: John "Picky" Brunious Interview, 1959-05-26
items.q: Then, uh, well, later on, that's where I joined, I joined up with John Kazmi. I played a lot of funerals and parades with John Kazmi.

ctx.x: Didn't have a name for it, like Tuxedo or?

Oh, they had a name for it, but I don't remember the name. Yeah, see? Then, uh, well, later on, that's where I joined, I joined up with John Kazmi. I played a lot of funerals and parades with John Kazmi. I played a couple of funerals and parades with the Eureka, and, uh, and then I played a couple of funerals, not funerals, I played some parades with George Williams. Yeah. See, George, because I don't think George Williams ever played a funeral, I don't know. He ever played a funeral. I don't think I ever saw him…
We have about five more minutes or so on here. All right. Is there anything else about the other bands you joined after?
